purpose: Execute only a current ready GraphReverifyRuntimeBinding against the same real runtime handles by invoking the existing canonical workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt surface, then optionally rejoin the resulting canonical verifier receipt as observation-only RuntimeEvidence through a separate explicit call.

execution.preflight: preflight_graph_reverify_runtime_binding must report ready=true immediately before execution

transaction.rollback_snapshot: AgentWorkspace is cloned immediately before canonical verifier invocation
transaction.success_postcondition: exactly one verifier receipt is appended, next receipt id advances exactly one, and exactly one of passed/failed verifier counters advances
transaction.canonical_error: workspace is restored from the clone
transaction.postcondition_mismatch: workspace is restored from the clone
transaction.numerical_mismatch: not an execution error; canonical failed verifier receipt remains committed

execution_result.execution_fingerprint: fnv1a64 correlation over binding/intent/dispatch + canonical verifier receipt id/outcome/raw receipt bytes
execution_result.fingerprint_security: deterministic correlation only; not authentication, authorization, integrity protection, or a capability token

validation: binding still correlates to current response intent
execution result matches binding/source evidence/dispatch fingerprints
adapted evidence outcome matches execution result
ResolutionEvidenceInbox exact-subject classification must accept the evidence

repeat_policy.rationale: reverify observes live current registry state; repeated explicit invocations may intentionally produce distinct verifier receipts even when the binding is unchanged

registry_state_policy.rule: execution uses the live LayerRegistry state after the current binding preflight
registry_state_policy.identity_boundary: mutable learned state is not promoted into CompiledGraph.programIdentity

invariants: the adapter cannot execute a non-reverify intent
the adapter cannot execute when GraphReverifyRuntimeBinding preflight is closed
the adapter never substitutes caller strings for runtime handles
the adapter calls the existing workspaceVerifyGraphReceipt canonical verifier surface
the execution result does not claim verifier authority
numerical failure remains a verifier outcome rather than an adapter error
canonical execution appends exactly one verifier receipt or the workspace is rolled back
execution itself does not mutate ResolutionEvidenceInbox
rejoin is a separate explicit operation
rejoin does not select the next agent action
rejoin does not create a Resolution transition or revision
agent remains selection authority for any subsequent response
